refs.title: Figure 32: Natural laughter by the voluntary contraction of the two large zygomatics and the lower palpebral orbicularis
refs.medium: Albumen print from glass plate negative
refs.licence: CC0 (Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access)
refs.feature: man's face, eye squeezed shut / grinning
refs.reason: natural laughter (real, not induced): crow's feet fanning from the outer corners, the eye narrowed from below by the cheek, the nasolabial fold curving round the lifted cheek; studied for structure only, the face itself is not used
